items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Because I kept in touch with him, and he knew where I was when he got this band together in New York.

ctx.x: Anyway, he sent for me... But see, I had... Somehow or another I had ended up keeping in touch with Jelly. Evidently, for some reason, he liked me. Now, why I don't know, because I couldn't play no clarinet, but I could play the soprano like a clarinet. And I have to give him credit, because evidently he took a liking to me. Because I kept in touch with him, and he knew where I was when he got this band together in New York. And evidently, he couldn't find no saxophone players. He got ahold of Procope and…
